manifest.name: @meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper
manifest.description: 扫雷浮层 / Minesweeper overlay for DeepSeek Harness — 在会话区左侧悬浮一块可拖动、可折叠、可自定义行列与雷数的扫雷盘，纯内存状态。
manifest.author: Mailemailezhu

bundle.text:
# @meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper 作为 bundle 安装时用的插件行（package.json 的 dsh.bundle.patch）。
#
# 两条安装路径共用这一份：
#   - `dsh plugin add @meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper`：声明了 dsh.bundle 之后，安装流程会把本文件
#     当作 profile 的一层 patch 加载，条目 id 就是下面的 `sweeper`；
#   - 手工装：在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里自己写一条等价的 insert 记录。
#
# 客户端半边（client.js）按 package.json 的 dsh.client 声明自动挂到同一个包名上，
# 不随这个 id 走，所以 id 只影响 Host 半边的命名空间。
- insert:
    - id: sweeper
      name: "@meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper"

readme.text: Minesweeper overlay for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). A draggable, collapsible board floats over the left side of the conversation area — the empty strip next to the sidebar — so you can play while the agent works.

- Custom board: rows and columns 5–30, mine count 1 … rows×cols−9.
- First click is always safe (mines are planted after it, avoiding the clicked cell and its ring).
- Right-click to flag, `↻` restarts the same board, `–` collapses to a single 💣 button.
- Losing reveals every mine plus the flags that were wrong; clearing every safe cell wins.
- Nothing is persisted: state lives in React memory and is gone when you refresh or stop the service.

```sh
dsh plugin add @meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper
```

Or install the npm package `@meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper` from the plugin market, then restart `dsh web`.

The panel registers into the `shell.overlay` slot (a list slot covering the whole frame), entry id `sweeper`, order 60. It positions itself absolutely inside that layer, so it never enters the `AppFrame` grid and never pushes the sidebar, conversation or composer around.

The host half (`index.js`) is intentionally empty: everything lives in the browser bundle (`client.js`). `cordis.patch.yml` exists so the package can be installed as a bundle.

```sh
npm run check   # node --check on both halves
npm test        # bundle contract + game core smoke test
```
